messages:
jordan: FYI billing spike traced to mismatch between provisional routing and final attribution.
maria: is this like the earlier exchange race?
kevin: similar but this time router accepted provisional HMAC proof then crashed during final reconciliation.
ankur: crash caused reconciliation consumer to drop events; corrections never applied.
jordan: logs: `recon-consumer panic: nil pointer on correction.event` then restart loop.
maria: ops: spin a consumer replica and add DLQ for failed corrections.
kevin: also need idempotency in correction events; include req_id + seq to dedupe.
ankur: billing wants compensating entries when corrections fail; need schema change.
billing-bot: created BILL-420: "compensating_charge_events" required fields: req_id, original_proj, final_proj, amount_delta, proofs[].
maria: UX: console should surface pending corrections and allow org admins to opt-in for auto-apply.
jordan: telemetry: add metric recon.failed_count and recon.dlq_size, alert if > 0 for 5m.
sre-bot: INF-910 created: "recon DLQ + replication" assigned @maria.
kevin: quick patch: consumer should ack on commit only after writing correction to DLQ on failure. PR in progress.
ankur: longer-term: move reconciliation into a transactional workflow using outbox pattern so router writes provisional and reconciliation uses the same source of truth.
maria: good plan. action items: KEVIN patch consumer, MARIA add DLQ + replica, ANKUR design outbox RFC, BILLING track schema.
jordan: canary once DLQ behaves on staging then 0.5% prod traffic. thanks all :thumbsup:
